content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity) at § 2.1 (p0012).**

- **Issue:** The USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment "without reduction or termination rights" is a Customer-payable minimum fee that functions as liquidated damages for the full remaining contract value — squarely against the playbook's preferred position and near the walk-away line. It also contradicts § 7.1 (no undisclosed minimum-use charge) and § 12.3 (Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment).
- **Direction check:** All other candidates run in our favour — § 7.3 (no interest on amounts not due), § 19.4 (refund remedy), § 27.3 (termination without penalty). No Vendor-side service-credit exhibit exists (only a passing reference in § 1.5), so nothing compliant to preserve there.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** Replaces the take-or-pay with a no-minimum/no-penalty statement and, per the fallback and precedent `seed-ld`, caps any early-termination fee at three months' Fees as our sole liability.
